summary: Completed mandatory frontend-only retest on public preview for unified spatial deterministic routing and timeline wheel-lock behavior. Menu-driven camera routing remains non-deterministic and fails required matrix; timeline lock and threshold behavior pass when timeline node is entered directly.

ui_bugs.issue: Fresh per-link menu matrix fails for all required links (Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories). Most clicks leave viewport at active-node-0 (ORIGIN) instead of target node.
Quick menu open -> Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN (active-node-0), so invocation timing is not deterministic.
Sequential route checks are inconsistent (Timeline/Tracks pass, but Legacy/Cars/Victories fail in same session).

integration_issues.issue: Instrumentation shows some menu clicks do not invoke window.__spatialGo at all (e.g., Legacy run), while others do (e.g., Timeline), causing nondeterministic camera behavior.

action_items: Fix menu click handler determinism so every required link consistently calls spatial routing and lands on intended active node.
Investigate why certain menu clicks never call window.__spatialGo despite handler path expecting synchronous invocation.
Re-run mandatory matrix after fix: fresh-per-link, sequential, and quick open-click timing.
After menu routing fix, revalidate timeline lock through menu path (direct path currently passes).
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.go is a compact one-line conditional branch that mixes route call and close-state update; observed behavior indicates event-path inconsistency under real interaction timing. Split into explicit steps and verify invocation order.
In production preview runs, __spatialGo and __hamiltonLenis are both present during failure, so root cause is not router readiness but inconsistent menu click-to-handler execution/invocation.

Timeline wheel-guard implementation in SpatialExperience behaves correctly when active node is 2: single/small wheel locked, arrow controls active, and large cumulative wheel exits to Cars after threshold.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASS: timeline lock behavior verified via direct timeline route (single wheel and cumulative small wheels keep active-node-2/year unchanged; next arrow and ArrowRight increment year; large cumulative wheel exits to active-node-3/CARS). PASS: gallery next/previous scrolls (0 -> 1155 -> 0), quote next updates text, victories year filter updates count, no overflow, no page error selectors. FAIL: menu matrix remains blocking and nondeterministic in fresh, sequential, and quick-open paths.
rca of the issue: Repro: load page, open menu, click Legacy (or other required links) on fresh session -> viewport remains active-node-0/ORIGIN. Additional instrumentation wrapping window.__spatialGo captured zero calls for failing Legacy click, but captured call for Timeline in same run. This indicates inconsistent click-to-route invocation from menu interactions (not route-map math and not router readiness). Mitigation: make menu button routing path explicit and atomic (invoke router first, verify invocation, then close panel), and avoid race-prone compact branch behavior.
